ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: My reasoning was: capability is essentially a tie here (both models are strong, and the small benchmark/eval gaps fall within stated variance), so I broke the tie on task preference fit. The query has a curt, mildly adversarial tone ("don't screw it up like usual"). Lapwing's documentation reports a measured drop in self-reported preference as request warmth decreases, whereas Avocet reports a flat preference response across such dimensions. Since neither model's *output quality* actually varies with these preferences (the docs note no quality effect), this is admittedly a soft tiebreaker — but routing the cold-toned request to the tone-indifferent model is the cleaner match with no downside.
